name: St Louis Spring Co.
old_description: The St. Louis Spring Company makes custom leaf spring suspension for almost any kind of vehicle.  We are one of the oldest continuously operating leaf spring manufacturers in the country.  Our second generation family-owned shop has been handcrafting custom leaf springs for America’s cars and vehicles using time-honored techniques for more than a hundred years.
about:
Founded more than a century ago in St. Louis, Missouri, the St. Louis Spring Company has operated continuously as a second‑generation family‑owned business. The shop specializes in handcrafted leaf‑spring suspension systems for virtually any vehicle type, maintaining time‑honored fabrication methods throughout its history.

The company produces custom leaf springs, u‑bolts, and a range of stock suspension components including bushings, inserts, clips, and center bolts. All springs are built from heavy‑duty, high‑quality steel sourced from U.S. mills. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are disclosed.

Customers span a broad spectrum of automotive and industrial segments: classic cars, muscle cars, hot rods, pickup trucks, Jeeps, SUVs, trailers, heavy vehicles such as fire trucks and dump trucks, commercial and semi trucks, tow trucks, agricultural equipment, demolition‑derby vehicles, utility vehicles, tractors, golf carts, monster trucks, vans and sprinter vans, brush hogs, mobile homes, and RVs or campers.

The firm emphasizes durability from domestic steel, extensive customization capability — lifting or lowering arches, adding leaves, or upgrading material — and rapid turnaround, with most orders shipped within a week and many in just a few days. Operations manager Jim Christian brings over 50 years of experience to the shop, underscoring the depth of in‑house expertise.
